# Cedric Stanhope

## Overview

- **Age:** Thirteen years old by Volume 3.  <sub>[v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Rank:** Student  <sub>[v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015)</sub>
- **Origin:** United States  <sub>[v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** A chip off the old block  <sub>[v1 c18 P36](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0036)</sub>

## Appearance

Cedric has a delicate, refined, and exceptionally beautiful face, with large, dark blue eyes, crimson lips, and a halo of chestnut curls. He is small for his age, with an expressive smile and features that resemble his mother and father.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P36](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0036), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027)_

## Personality

Cedric is an imaginative, sensitive, and thoughtful boy with a deep, poetic nature. He is polite, well-mannered, and honest, bonding quickly with those who understand his imaginative world, like Nell. Despite his gentle and dreamy demeanor, he possesses a proud, manly spirit and will stand up for his beliefs.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 c27 P41](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0041), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038)_

## History

Cedric Stanhope was born in the United States to Stephen Stanhope and his wife, who passed away when Cedric was ten years old. Following her death, his father sent him to Brierley on St. Brendan's Island to live with his grandmother on the shore road. Upon attending Brierley school, he instantly formed a deep friendship with his teacher, Nell Harcourt, who appreciated his rich imagination and kindred spirit. During the winter, Cedric saved the life of little Posy Fay Pembroke when she suffered from croup, administering ipecac until the doctor arrived. He became a star pupil under Miss Agnes Thorne, excelling in his studies and writing imaginative stories for the school's story club. Cedric also befriended Miss Rosalind Penrose at Echo Cottage, helping re-ignite a romance between her and his father, Stephen Stanhope, when the latter visited Brierley. Over the years, Cedric grew significantly in height and maturity, eventually turning thirteen and continuing to write poetry while maintaining his bond with Nell and his family.

_Sources: [v1 c18 P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 c18 P30](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0030), [v1 c18 P35](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0035), [v1 c27 P15](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0015), [v2 c5 P8](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0008), [v2 c5 P21](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0021), [v2 c11 P38](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0038), [v2 c19 P22](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0022), [v2 c23 P27](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0027), [v2 c26 P4](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0004), [v2 c26 P20](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0020)_
